title: useInterval Hook
description:
Implement a `useInterval` hook that calls `callback` on a repeating interval of `delay` ms. The interval clears automatically on unmount, and resets when `delay` changes.

**Example:**
```tsx
useInterval(() => setCount(c => c + 1), 1000);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: putting callback directly in the dependency array, causing the interval to reset on every render when callback is an inline function. The useRef pattern stabilises the reference so only delay changes restart the interval.
